title: Water at Dholavira
body: Dholavira, in the Rann of Kutch in Gujarat, lies in a dry region. Its people built at least six large reservoirs, some with stones and some cut into the rock itself. One rock-cut reservoir measures about 33 metres in length. Most of the reservoirs were connected through underground drains. Since the reservoirs had to be cleaned from time to time, someone must have organised a large number of workers, given them precise instructions and looked after the maintenance of the system.
